Class_Skill_Desc_Occult Blizzard III: Deals ice damage with a potency of 400 to target and all enemies nearby it.</br>Potency increases to 520 when used against targets weak to ice.</br>Potency scales with item level.</br>Shares a recast timer with Occult Fire III and Occult Thunder III.
Class_Skill_Desc_Occult Fire III: Deals fire damage with a potency of 400 to target and all enemies nearby it.</br>Potency increases to 520 when used against targets weak to fire.</br>Potency scales with item level.</br>Shares a recast timer with Occult Blizzard III and Occult Thunder III.
Class_Skill_Desc_Occult Flare: Deals unaspected damage with a potency of 500 to target and all enemies nearby it.</br>Potency scales with item level.
Class_Skill_Desc_Occult Thunder III: Deals lightning damage with a potency of 400 to target and all enemies nearby it.</br>Potency increases to 520 when used against targets weak to lightning.</br>Potency scales with item level.</br>Shares a recast timer with Occult Fire III and Occult Blizzard III.
Class_Skill_Desc_Occult Toad: Afflicts target with Occult Toad.</br>Occult Toad Effect: Reduces target's damage dealt by 99%, and prevents the execution of actions save for auto-attack</br>Duration: 20s
